$comment: Single logical source for hooks. scripts/gen-hooks.mjs reads this to emit .github/hooks/*.json (Copilot adapter, ADR-001). Editing hook behavior: edit the referenced .sh script; edit event wiring: edit this file, then run `pnpm gen-hooks`.

hooks.description: Deny rm -rf outside scratch paths, force-push, hard reset, direct secret reads.
Deny writes that resolve outside the repository root.
Deny dangerouslySetInnerHTML without a sanitizer call in the same edit.
Redact likely secrets/tokens from Bash output before it re-enters context.
Run prettier --write (+ eslint --fix for JS/TS) on the edited file.
The green gate. Runs scripts/verify.sh --json and applies the ratchet (SPEC.md §5).
Same ratchet, applied when a subagent (e.g. implementer) finishes its turn.
Append one observability line per tool call to .claude/logs/metrics.jsonl.
